title.narrative: Enabling digital solutions for deforestation-free commodities from smallholders (DigiDeFree)

description.narrative: To protect forests, the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) stipulates that the import of various agricultural products to European Union requires proof of deforestation-free production. This is a challenge for small-scale producers who lack information and the financial and technical means to provide proof. To maintain their market access, the project supports Mexican small-scale coffee and cocoa producers’ cooperatives through capacity building and the development of a digital tool for data generation and verification of deforestation-free production, based on the participatorily developed requirements of local stakeholders. Local promoters use the tool to support small-scale producers in implementing and verifying the deforestation-free status of coffee and cocoa. To strengthen North-South cooperation, actors along the supply chain are building a joint responsibility framework. Synergies with other projects, networks of stakeholders and the use of the ELAN platform create multiplier effects.
